findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent non-development calls to GetWebAssets can all observe a nil cache before the first caller acquires the write lock. Although the first caller then populates the cache, every queued caller still reloads and decodes the manifest while holding the exclusive lock. This serializes redundant initialization work and blocks other cache readers, increasing cold-start request latency with the number of concurrent cache misses. After acquiring the write lock, recheck entryPointAssetsCache and return it when populated, while preserving the reload behavior in development mode.
